goal_contract.problem: Add a production-grade stenographer to Dashen that records microphone and system audio locally, transcribes Chinese speech, distinguishes speakers, preserves inline edits and images, and returns complete GLM-5.3-Flash writing artifacts in the panel.
goal_contract.audience_action: The user can run real meetings through one stable panel and immediately continue with minutes, a report email, a requirements document, or a custom processing purpose without manual setup.
deliverables: Native microphone, system-audio and dual-track recording in /Applications/大神.app
Local FunASR ERes2NetV2 speaker runtime and MLX Whisper transcription runtime
Persistent stenographer host extension and structured document store
Editable stenographer panel with transcript, speaker names, text and image blocks
Final reconciliation, GLM-5.3-Flash artifact generation, full-text return and one-click copy
Focused tests, full regression evidence, real UI evidence and delivery manifest
goal_contract.minimum_deliverable: none: no reduced or MVP release is accepted; all critical release gates must pass

debug_notes: Synthetic audio may be used for repeatable tests but is never user meeting evidence.
pollution_risks: Existing dirty worktree changes must not be reverted or mixed into this feature.
The current mlx-audio streaming path corrupts some Chinese output and timestamps and may not be used without a passing regression.
FunASR ClusterBackend assigns one speaker for fewer than 20 embeddings and the stock realtime tracker retains only 128 chunks; neither default is production-safe for long meetings.
Local passing tests do not prove real microphone, ScreenCaptureKit, UI or long-run acceptance.

output_contract.cloud_boundary: audio remains local; only finalized transcript text is sent after the user explicitly requests an artifact
output_contract.ui_location: conversation header utility and right-side panel
forbidden: DOM click hacks for session submission
claiming production readiness without real app evidence

nodes.goal: Lock the full production outcome and authorization.
Freeze local runtime, model, UI and dirty-worktree truth.
Lock native, host, model, UI, persistence and handoff interfaces.
Implement native capture, local runtime, host persistence, panel editor and handoff.

checks: artifact generation is pinned to GLM-5.3-Flash

nodes.goal: Run focused, integration, full regression, performance, offline and real UI validation.
Install the accepted app and package the exact feature changes and model manifest.

checks: rollback is field and file scoped

nodes.goal: Read back every user requirement and report readiness without overclaiming.

checks: implementation, tests, regression, real UI and production readiness reported separately
